method: Grouped by where each case is in its news cycle, not by guilt. Dates and statuses were checked on Nov. 18 against court coverage and our sourced court calendar; where a date comes from fewer than three independent sources it is marked reported.

phases.label: Building up
phases.blurb: A big court moment is coming. Attention usually grows for weeks beforehand, longest before a trial.

phases.label: In the spotlight now
phases.blurb: A major moment just happened or is happening. Attention tends to peak for about a week.

phases.label: Past the peak
phases.blurb: The big moment has passed. Attention usually falls to a small fraction of its peak within one to four weeks, unless a new court date arrives.

cases.title: Maggie and Paul Murdaugh: Alex Murdaugh's retrial
cases.status: AWAITING RETRIAL · RULING EXPECTED THIS WEEK
cases.why: His 2023 murder convictions were overturned in May 2026. A judge heard his motion to dismiss the murder indictments on Nov. 13, and a written ruling is expected this week. The retrial is set for April 5, 2027, a date that can change. He is presumed innocent of the murder charges.

cases.title: The Lindsay Clancy case
cases.why: Her trial ended in a mistrial on Sept. 4, 2026, which is not a verdict. On Nov. 9 the judge denied her motion to dismiss, and a retrial is set for March 29, 2027, with a status hearing on Dec. 30. She has pleaded not guilty and is presumed innocent.

cases.title: The Richard Glossip case
cases.status: PLEA ENTERED NOV. 12 · SENTENCING REPORTED DEC. 17
cases.why: On Nov. 12, 2026, Oklahoma prosecutors dropped the first-degree murder charge and Richard Glossip pleaded guilty to a lesser charge in the 1997 death of Barry Van Treese. The attorney general's office calls it accessory to first-degree murder; his defense calls it accessory after the fact. He has not been sentenced. Sentencing is reported for Dec. 17; AP says only that it is in December.

cases.title: The Dwain Hall trial
cases.status: ON TRIAL · JURY SELECTION BEGAN NOV. 16
cases.why: Dwain Hall is on trial in Marion County, Florida, charged with first-degree murder and kidnapping. Jury selection began Nov. 16, and the trial is reported to last about a week, so a verdict could come soon. He is presumed innocent.

cases.title: The Naresh Bhatt case
cases.status: CONVICTED NOV. 10 · SENTENCING SET FOR MARCH 12, 2027
cases.why: A Prince William County, Virginia, jury found Naresh Bhatt guilty on all counts on Nov. 10, 2026, in the death of his wife, Mamta Kafle Bhatt. Sentencing is scheduled for March 12, 2027.

cases.title: The Idaho student murders: the Bryan Kohberger case
cases.why: Kaylee Goncalves, Madison Mogen, Xana Kernodle and Ethan Chapin were killed in 2022. Kohberger pleaded guilty and was sentenced to life without parole in July 2025. A post-conviction petition is pending.

cases.title: The Jared Bridegan case
cases.why: A jury found Mario Fernandez Saldana guilty of first-degree murder on Aug. 26, 2026. We have not confirmed a sentencing date. Shanna Gardner and Henry Tenon are charged and presumed innocent; their trial is set for 2027.
